items.title: Jacory Croskey-Merritt: Trending toward playing Monday
items.text:
Croskey-Merritt (groin) is trending toward playing in Monday night's game against the Bengals, Nicki Jhabvala of The Athletic reports.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Josh Jacobs: Unlikely to play Wednesday
items.text:
Jacobs (finger) isn't expected to play Wednesday against the Rams, Matt Schneidman of The Athletic reports.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Carnell Tate: Expected to play Sunday
items.text:
Tate (shoulder) is questionable for Sunday's game against the Cowboys but is "considered likely" to be cleared to play, Matt Zenitz of CBS Sports reports.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Rachaad White: Not spotted at Saturday's practice
items.text:
White (heel) was not on the field during the opening portion of Saturday's practice session, Nicki Jhabvala of The Athletic reports.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Baker Mayfield: Working through plantar fascia injury
items.text:
Mayfield (thumb) is dealing with a plantar fascia injury in his foot, and he would wear a special orthotic and new cleats to stabilize his foot if he's cleared to play against the Lions on Sunday, Tom Pelissero of The Ringer and Netflix reports.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.
